since $OA$ bisects $\angle BOD$, $AE\perp OD$, and $AC\perp OB$, \\

Since the distance from point A to the y-axis is 4, \\

Since point A is in the second quadrant, \\

From the text, take AC perpendicular to OB, AC=3, and OA as the angle bisector of angle BOD. Since A lies on the angle bisector, its perpendicular distances to the two sides OB and OD are equal.
